descriptions.d24d_jetpack_update_8014d7c8: Updates a worm's jetpack at +784: computes the stop flag from +716, +1152, +1204 and +824 and reports it (0x800ac14c); updates the offset (+572) and velocity (+676) through 0x800aa628 and 0x800aabbc, creates the Worm Jetpack Active slot when needed, and places the jetpack 22 above the worm (0x800abbb4).
